fields.pick_no: Overall pick number, 1..pick_count. Unique, gap-free, and the array order.
fields.pick_in_round: Position within the round, 1..teams. Differs from draft_slot in a reversed round — in round 2 of a 10-team snake, pick_in_round 1 is draft_slot 10.
fields.draft_slot: The board column this pick belongs to, 1..teams.
fields.roster_id: The team that receives the player (the ESPN team id) — the current owner, which is not the slot's original owner if the pick was traded.
fields.user_id: The member that owns the pick (the ESPN SWID). Null if the draft order is unpublished or the team has no member.
fields.username: That member's display name. Null if the member list was unreadable.
fields.is_mine: True for the configured owner's picks (see `me` in the header).
fields.status: 'made' — ESPN has recorded a selection — or 'pending'.
fields.sleeper_id: Sleeper player id of the selection, translated from the ESPN pick; null while pending or unmatched. This is the join key back to pool.json's sleeper_id.
fields.name: Sleeper's name for the selection, for reading the file by eye. Informational: the pool carries the projection provider's own name, and joins go by sleeper_id.
fields.position: Sleeper's position for the selection. Informational, as above.
fields.team: Sleeper's NFL team for the selection. Informational, as above.
fields.is_keeper: True when ESPN flagged the pick as a keeper. False for a normal pick.
